description: This file defines classes and functions related to forward automatic differentiation (AD) gradients in PyTorch's autograd system, including management of gradient levels and storage of forward gradients.

classes.name: ForwardADLevel
classes.description: Manages gradient levels for forward AD, including creation, deletion, and access by index.

classes.name: ForwardGrad
classes.description: Stores forward AD gradients and manages their association with gradient levels.

methods.name: ForwardADLevel::get_next_idx
methods.description: Generates a new unique index for a gradient level.

methods.name: ForwardADLevel::release_idx
methods.description: Releases a previously allocated gradient level index.

methods.name: ForwardADLevel::get_by_idx
methods.description: Retrieves the ForwardADLevel instance associated with a given index.

methods.name: ForwardGrad::set_value
methods.description: Associates a tensor value with a specific gradient level.

methods.name: ForwardGrad::reset
methods.description: Removes the gradient tensor for a specific level, optionally updating the level registry.

methods.name: ForwardGrad::clear
methods.description: Clears all stored gradients and unregisters from levels, typically called during destruction.
